It is the only ortho report with checkboxes (MISSING: Ledger Transaction and Ortho Visit, both ticked) and with two separate provider pickers (Appointment Provider and Visit Doctor, both ALL). The header pixels look like 'MISSINC', 'OFFICE/CROUP' and 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANCE' because the header font draws G almost like C at this size (see observations); they are MISSING, OFFICE/GROUP and APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE.

observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 5 original screenshots (1366 px wide, 580-594 px high), the 10 pre-rendered zooms and about 45 additional tight crops (prefix c in the zoom folder) were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option list, default value, enabled state and truncation flag (5 reports, 24 sections, 36 controls); their differences were note wording only. Every point was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels: the selected list radio of every file, blue-mark counts for every selected criteria radio and ticked checkbox, a colour census of every blue button, a fill-colour census of every input box, and a cluster map of every pixel in each criteria panel that is not one of the flat fill colours. Nothing exists beyond the controls listed here: no tiny right-edge checkbox (no 'Page Break'), no second column of controls, no greyed-out control, no instruction / warning / legend text, no dropdown, no listbox, no scrollbar on either panel and no footer text. COVERAGE: 5 screenshots = 5 reports, each selected exactly once, in list order: 1.PNG = Ortho Compliance Report, 2.PNG = Ortho Daily Journal, 3.PNG = Patients by Ortho Status with Time in Treatment, 4.PNG = Ortho Report, 5.PNG = Missing Ortho Visits. Every listed report has a screenshot. All five are the normal two-panel screen - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no opened picker, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen - so the dialogs behind the SELECT buttons (office / office group, provider, appointment provider, visit doctor, ortho status) and therefore the list of ortho status values are NOT documented by this category. Only one state per report was captured, so the non-default states (Excel, Office Group, unticked MISSING boxes) are not shown either. TITLE BAR (identical in all 5): 'Ortho Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (icon only, no text) at the far right. LEFT PANEL 'SELECT REPORT': 5 radio entries in a two-column bordered grid - left column: Ortho Compliance Report, Ortho Daily Journal, Patients by Ortho Status with Time in Treatment (the label wraps onto two lines); right column: Ortho Report, Missing Ortho Visits (the third right-hand cell is empty). The rest of the panel is uniform empty navy down to the window edge, so the list is NOT scrollable or clipped. A splitter / collapse grip (three dots in a notch) sits between the two panels. RIGHT PANEL 'REPORT CRITERIA': the grey-styled CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) sits at the right end of the blue header bar - same grey look in all 5 files and in the other report categories, so it is its normal style, not a disabled state; the blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon) buttons sit in a grey action bar pinned to the bottom of the panel. Every criteria panel ends well above that bar, so no report is truncated. RECURRING PATTERNS: PRINT FORMAT (PDF / Excel, PDF selected) is on all 5 reports - first and full-width on four of them, top-right beside MISSING on Missing Ortho Visits. OFFICE/GROUP (Office / Office Group radios, Office selected, plus an unlabelled read-only box showing 108 with a building-icon SELECT button) is on all 5 reports. Provider-type pickers (row label + read-only box ALL + person-icon SELECT) exist only on Ortho Compliance Report (Provider), Ortho Daily Journal (Provider) and Missing Ortho Visits (Appointment Provider and Visit Doctor). The ORTHO STATUS picker (unlabelled box ALL + building-icon SELECT) exists on Patients by Ortho Status with Time in Treatment and on Ortho Report; these two reports are identical except for the second date header (PATIENT LAST VISIT vs PATIENT FIRST VISIT) and the date-box contents. None of the five reports has REPORT FORMAT, GROUP BY, SORT BY, PATIENT TYPE or OTHER OPTIONS sections. FILLS: picker boxes use the darker read-only grey fill (RGB 220,223,226); date boxes and the weeks box use the lighter editable fill (RGB 241,241,241). All labels are black and all SELECT buttons are blue, i.e. every control is enabled. DATE CONTENTS: Ortho Daily Journal, Ortho Report and Missing Ortho Visits show 11/21/2026 in every date box - the day the screenshots were captured, so these fields default to the current date (inference). Patients by Ortho Status with Time in Treatment shows all four date boxes blank with the placeholder 'Select Date'. TEXT-RENDERING CAVEAT: the small bold caps font of the grey section headers draws a capital G almost like a C, so the pixels look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'MISSINC' and 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANCE'. A pixel dump shows the disputed glyph is asymmetric (heavier lower-right terminal) while the true C in OFFICE and in SINCE is symmetric, the mixed-case radio label clearly reads 'Office Group', and the other verified categories carry the same header; the titles are therefore recorded as OFFICE/GROUP, MISSING and APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE. The value font draws '11' with flat-topped ones (can look like 'TI'); the dates read 11/21/2026. MINOR CAPTURE DIFFERENCES: 4.PNG includes a 5 px strip of the host application's bright-blue top bar above the title bar (white fragments, no legible text) and 5.PNG a 2 px line of it; 2.PNG is cropped about 4 px tighter at the top; 1.PNG, 4.PNG and 5.PNG end with a thin grey window-edge strip below the panels. None of this carries report content.
